Every τ (z) of dimension d constructible by MQSP allows a M-QSP protocol over SU (d). The stronger guarantee on the dimension in the univariate case given by Theorem 4.8 relies on the uniqueness of the catalyst matrix X in (16), while the example in (19) clearly shows distinct possible solutions (which in turn includes also any convex combination). It is worth mentioning that previous impossibility proofs in [40, 41] only talk about total states in a specific dimension.
